The '''Royal Chambers''' were the personal residence of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] while visiting [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]].

==History==
{{Quote|Where is Master C'baoth now?''"''<br />''"''Up in the Emperor's old royal chambers. General Covell insisted they be opened for him.|Grand Admiral Thrawn and Colonel Kleyn Selid|<ref name="The Last Command" />}}
At some point, Palpatine put the entire mountain, including the Royal Chambers, under the protection of a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Guardian of Mount Tantiss|Guardian]].<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>

At some point prior to [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], [[Joruus C'baoth]], the insane [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Jorus C'baoth]] arrived on Wayland and killed the [[Guardian]], taking up residence in the mountain.<ref name="Heir to the Empire" /> He eventually allied himself with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], but broke it off, causing Thrawn to imprison him inside Mount Tantiss, along with putting [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Force suppression|repelling]] [[Ysalamiri/Legends|ysalamir]] around the mountain.<ref name="The Last Command" />

As he was being transported, however, C'baoth took control of the mind of one of the Imperials guarding him, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Freja Covell]], and replaced parts of it with his own. He made him order the Royal Chambers be opened for C'baoth, before dying upon reaching the mountain, due to the ysalamir cutting off the clone's Force abilities and the general's mind being unable to withstand not being under C'baoth's control. Thrawn allowed C'baoth to roam free around the chambers and [[Throne Room Complex (Wayland)|throne room]] but without the ability to leave, along with ordering that the control circuits on the floor be disabled. The Royal Chambers were eventually destroyed during an [[Assault on Mount Tantiss|attack on the mountain]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Smugglers' Alliance]].<ref name="The Last Command" />

==Layout==
The Royal Chambers were on the second-to-top floor of the Emperor's secret storehouse in Mount Tantiss, just below the throne room. The chambers took up three levels and had only one [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolift]] stop. They consisted of a meeting room for the Emperor and his advisors, an information station to access the mountain's data vaults, and other amenities for the Emperor's comfort. Additionally, the Royal Chambers housed a library that contained a repository of information about the Force.<ref name="The Last Command Sourcebook" />
